::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 31st 1855  
**From:** Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Mitchell Library,  State Library of New South Wales. A1 p 7,  Reel CY1592  17-18.
:::

My dear [Sir](people/person_1143.qmd)
I am much obliged by your flattering offer but I do not wish to depart from my rule of never parting with my copyright

My present view is to print 5000 at my own cost, requesting you to publish them on commission.

My own work in the M.S is not fully completed but I hope soon to have it ready

Yours truly
C M Yonge

I should be obliged if you would send me a copy of [Redclyffe](cmy_books/cmybook_15.qmd) [Heartsease](cmy_books/cmybook_19.qmd) &amp; the [Little Duke](cmy_books/cmybook_20.qmd)
